review_notes: I read the whole target file. It contains only two theorems: a product identity N(α,β)·N(-α,-β) = -(p+1)², and an iff characterising when N(-α,-β) = -N(α,β). It defines no function or construction, so there is no map whose homomorphism, continuity, equivalence or action structure could be left unbundled. The structureConstant definition is in Basic.lean, outside this file. Its dependence on the dependent hypotheses (γ, hγ, hαβ) is a different kind of issue from the rubric's. I also grepped the Weights directory. The consumers (Twist.lean, Involution.lean, Normalization.lean) use these lemmas as scalar identities, and I found no standard Mathlib bundle that fits. Remaining uncertainty is small: I did not read Basic.lean in full.
